explain.es: Una cleft sentence (frase escindida) parte una oración en dos para poner el foco en un elemento: quién, qué, cuándo, dónde o por qué. El español hace lo mismo con «Fue Ana quien…» o «Lo que necesito es…». Como el orden de palabras del inglés es rígido y no podemos mover los elementos con tanta libertad, las cleft sentences son una herramienta clave para el énfasis, el contraste y la corrección, tanto en el habla como en textos formales.
explain.en: A cleft sentence splits one clause into two to focus on one element. English word order is fixed, so clefts are a key tool for emphasis, contrast and correction.

explain.title: 1 · It-cleft: It is / was … that / who
explain.es: Colocamos el elemento destacado entre It is / It was y that (o who si es una persona). Podemos destacar el sujeto, el objeto o un complemento de tiempo, lugar o causa. El foco suele ser información nueva o contrastiva (fue X, y no Y). Be va siempre en singular aunque el foco sea plural (It was the interns who…), y su tiempo suele coincidir con el de la frase.
explain.en: Put the focus between It is / It was and that / who. The focus can be the subject, the object or an adverbial. It is / was is always singular.
formula: It is / It was + *elemento destacado* + that / who + resto de la frase

examples.en: It was the finance director who approved the payment.
examples.es: Fue el director financiero quien aprobó el pago.

examples.en: It's the lack of transparency that worries investors.
examples.es: Es la falta de transparencia lo que preocupa a los inversores.

examples.en: It was in Geneva that the agreement was finally signed.
examples.es: Fue en Ginebra donde por fin se firmó el acuerdo.

Implica… · Implies

al consejo, no a los clientes

explain.title: 2 · It wasn't until… / It was only when…
explain.title_en: Not until, only when and contrast
explain.es: Tres fórmulas muy rentables en el C1: It wasn't until + tiempo o cláusula + that… (= no … hasta), It was only when / after … that… (= solo cuando / después) y la estructura de contraste It's not X that…, it's Y (= no es X lo que…, sino Y). En todas ellas se usa that, no when.
explain.en: It wasn't until … that…, It was only when … that… and It's not X that…, it's Y. Use that, not when.
formula: It wasn't until + tiempo / cláusula + *that* + frase

examples.en: It wasn't until the third quarter that sales began to recover.
examples.es: Las ventas no empezaron a recuperarse hasta el tercer trimestre.

examples.en: It was only when I read the small print that I understood the risks.
examples.es: Solo cuando leí la letra pequeña entendí los riesgos.

examples.en: It isn't the money that bothers me; it's the principle.
examples.es: No es el dinero lo que me molesta; es una cuestión de principios.

explain.title: 3 · Wh-cleft: What … is / was
explain.es: Empieza por What (= lo que) + sujeto + verbo; después va be y, al final, la información nueva, justo donde el inglés coloca el foco natural. Es el equivalente de «Lo que… es…» y crea expectación. Muy frecuente con verbos de opinión y sentimiento: need, want, like, hate, worry, surprise, matter, concern, impress. Nunca se añade it antes de is.
explain.en: What + clause + be + focus. The new information goes at the end and builds suspense. Never add it before is.

examples.en: What the company needs is a clear long-term strategy.
examples.es: Lo que necesita la empresa es una estrategia clara a largo plazo.

examples.en: What surprised me most was the candidate's lack of preparation.
examples.es: Lo que más me sorprendió fue la falta de preparación del candidato.

examples.en: What really matters is how we respond to the crisis.
examples.es: Lo que de verdad importa es cómo respondemos a la crisis.

explain.title: 4 · What … did was + infinitivo
explain.es: Para destacar una acción usamos do en la primera parte: What I did was… Detrás de be va el infinitivo con o sin to (sin to es más frecuente): What she did was (to) resign. El tiempo lo marca do: What we're going to do is… Si la primera parte va en continuo, el foco va en -ing: What I'm doing is trying to help. Para destacar todo un suceso: What happened was (that) + frase completa.
explain.en: To focus on an action, use do: What I did was (to) + infinitive. For a whole event: What happened was (that)…
formula: What + sujeto + *do / did / will do* + *be* + (to) infinitivo

examples.en: What the CEO did was (to) cut her own salary by 30%.
examples.es: Lo que hizo la consejera delegada fue recortarse el sueldo un 30 %.

examples.en: What we're going to do is review every single contract.
examples.es: Lo que vamos a hacer es revisar todos y cada uno de los contratos.

examples.en: What happened was that the server crashed during the presentation.
examples.es: Lo que pasó fue que el servidor se cayó durante la presentación.

explain.title: 5 · All, The thing, The reason…
explain.es: Variantes muy naturales: All (that) = lo único que (All I want is…; nunca all what); The (only / main) thing (that); The reason (why) … is that / is to + infinitivo (nunca the reason because); The person who, The place where, The day when. También con where y why en wh-cleft: Where we went wrong was…
explain.en: All (that), the thing (that), the reason (why), the person who, the place where… + be + focus. Never all what or the reason because.
formula: All / The thing / The reason (why) + cláusula + *is / was* + foco

examples.en: All we're asking for is a fair hearing.
examples.es: Lo único que pedimos es que se nos escuche con imparcialidad.

examples.en: The reason why the project failed was that nobody took responsibility.
examples.es: La razón por la que fracasó el proyecto fue que nadie asumió la responsabilidad.

examples.en: The thing that impressed me most was her attention to detail.
examples.es: Lo que más me impresionó fue su atención al detalle.

examples.en: The place where we first met was a small café in Lisbon.
examples.es: El sitio donde nos conocimos fue un pequeño café de Lisboa.

explain.title: 6 · Al revés: That's what… / This is where…
explain.es: Podemos dar la vuelta al wh-cleft y poner el foco al principio: A good rest is what you need. Con this / that es una fórmula muy natural en conversaciones y presentaciones: That's what I mean · This is where things get complicated · That's why we're here · That's how it works.
explain.en: Reversed wh-clefts put the focus first: A good rest is what you need. With this / that they are very common in speech.
formula: Foco / This / That + *is* + what / where / why / how + cláusula

examples.es: La transparencia es lo que esperan nuestros clientes.

examples.en: This is where the plan starts to fall apart.
examples.es: Aquí es donde el plan empieza a venirse abajo.

examples.en: That's why we decided to postpone the launch.
examples.es: Por eso decidimos aplazar el lanzamiento.

explain.title: It-cleft frente a wh-cleft
explain.es: Con It el foco va delante y suele marcar contraste (¡fue X, no Y!). Con What el foco va al final y crea expectación. Las dos traducen el «es … lo que / fue … quien» del español.
explain.en: It-clefts put the focus first (often contrastive); wh-clefts put it last, building suspense.

items.es: Escribe la frase neutra y decide qué quieres destacar: The delay annoyed the clients.
items.en: Write the neutral sentence and choose the focus.

items.es: ¿Foco delante, con contraste (fue X, no Y)? → It was the delay that annoyed the clients.
items.en: Focus first, contrastive → It was … that.

items.es: ¿Foco al final, creando expectación? → What annoyed the clients was the delay.
¿Destacas una acción? Usa do: What we did was (to) apologise.
Revisa: what (no that) para «lo que», that / who tras el foco, un solo be y sin it extra.
items.en: Check: what, that / who, one be, no extra it.

lines.en: So, what went wrong with the launch?
Well, it wasn't the product that failed. It was the timing.
lines.es: Bueno, no fue el producto lo que falló. Fue el momento.

lines.en: What happened was that our main competitor launched a similar app a week earlier.
lines.es: Lo que pasó fue que nuestro principal competidor lanzó una app parecida una semana antes.

lines.en: The reason why we didn't react was that nobody had analysed the market.

lines.en: What we need is a proper research team. All I'm asking for is two analysts.
lines.es: Lo que necesitamos es un equipo de investigación de verdad. Lo único que pido son dos analistas.

explain.title: Truco del «lo que»
explain.es: Si en español empiezas con «Lo que…», en inglés empieza con What… (nunca That). Si dices «Es / Fue X quien / lo que / donde…», piensa en It is / was X that / who…. Para «lo único que», All. En una presentación, abrir con What I'd like to do today is… suena seguro y profesional.
explain.en: «Lo que…» → What… · «Es / Fue X quien…» → It is / was X that / who… · «Lo único que…» → All…

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee el texto (parte de una charla de una emprendedora). Marca T o F y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read the talk. Tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: When people ask me what nearly destroyed our start-up, they expect me to say money. But it wasn't money that almost finished us. It was silence. What I mean is that, for almost a year, nobody in the team dared to tell me the truth.

It was only when our biggest client left that I started asking questions. What I discovered was shocking: our developers had been warning about serious bugs for months, but their emails never reached me. The reason why they never reached me was simple: my managers were afraid of my reaction.

What we did next changed everything. We introduced a weekly meeting where anyone can say anything. All I ask is that people are honest and respectful. It's this culture of openness, not our product, that our clients value most today.

items.q: Money was the main problem for the start-up.
items.why: It wasn't money that almost finished us. It was silence.

items.q: The author started asking questions after losing a major client.
items.why: It was only when our biggest client left that…

items.q: The developers had never reported any problems.
items.why: They had been warning about serious bugs for months.

items.q: Why did the developers' emails never reach the author?
items.a: Because the managers were afraid of her reaction.

items.q: What did the company introduce?
items.a: A weekly meeting where anyone can say anything.

items.q: Copy the sentence that begins with All.
items.a: All I ask is that people are honest and respectful.

items.q: Rewrite without a cleft: "It's this culture of openness that our clients value most today."
items.a: Our clients value this culture of openness most today.

items.q: Rewrite as a wh-cleft: "Silence almost finished us."
items.a: What almost finished us was silence.

exercises.title: Ahora escribe tú
exercises.es: Escribe frases propias con cleft sentences, pensando en situaciones reales de trabajo o estudio.
exercises.en: Write your own cleft sentences for real work or study situations.

items.q: Empieza una presentación con What I'd like to talk about today is…
items.a: Ej.: What I'd like to talk about today is how we can reduce our carbon footprint.

items.q: Corrige un malentendido con It wasn't … who / that …; it was …
items.a: Ej.: It wasn't me who cancelled the meeting; it was the client.

items.q: Explica el motivo de un email formal con The reason why I am writing is…
items.a: Ej.: The reason why I am writing is to request a refund for my order.

items.q: Cuenta un problema con What happened was that…
items.a: Ej.: What happened was that my flight was cancelled and I missed the conference.

items.q: Expresa un deseo con All I… y una opinión con What really matters is…
items.a: Ej.: All I want is a bit more flexibility. What really matters is that we work well together.

checklist.es: Construyo It is / was … that / who para destacar quién, qué, cuándo o dónde.
Uso What … is / was para «lo que … es».
Destaco acciones con What I did was (to) + infinitivo y sucesos con What happened was…
checklist.en: I can focus on actions and events.

checklist.es: Uso All, The thing, The reason why y The place where.
checklist.en: I can use all, the thing, the reason why…

checklist.es: Uso It wasn't until … that y It's not X that…, it's Y.
checklist.en: I can use not until and contrastive clefts.

checklist.es: Evito <s>What I need it's</s>, <s>all what</s> y <s>the reason because</s>.
